###Function to Retrieve Commmand Line slices in R


```{r}
render_overlay <- function(MNIcoord,filePath,overlay,folderPath,fileName) {
  intern = FALSE
  ignore.stdout = FALSE
  ignore.stderr = FALSE
  wait = TRUE
  input = NULL
  
   view1 <- paste0("volblend -r ",filePath," --view 1 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",folderPath, fileName,"1.png")
   view2 <- paste0("volblend -r ",filePath," --view 2 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",folderPath, fileName,"2.png")
   view3 <- paste0("volblend -r ",filePath," --view 3 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",folderPath, fileName,"3.png")
  
  return(c(system(view1, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view2, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view3, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input)))
}

#render_overlay(coord = c(x,y,z), filePath = "path to volume", overlay = "path to overlay", fileName = "path to tbm_anova folder and png name")

render_overlay(MNIcoord = 107, filePath="/Applications/BrainSuite17a/svreg/BrainSuiteAtlas1/mri.bfc.nii.gz", overlay="~/Desktop/tbm_anova/bss_anova_age_mri.bfc.nii_log_pvalues.nii.gz", folderPath = "/Users/sarapesavento/Desktop/tbm_anova/", fileName = "Pvalue")
```

###Read in Volumes

```{r}
render_atlas <- function(MNIcoord,filePath,folderPath,atlasName) {
  intern = FALSE
  ignore.stdout = FALSE
  ignore.stderr = FALSE
  wait = TRUE
  input = NULL
  
   view1 <- paste0("volblend -i ",filePath," --view 1 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", folderPath, atlasName,"_1.png")
   view2 <- paste0("volblend -i ",filePath," --view 2 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", folderPath, atlasName,"_2.png")
   view3 <- paste0("volblend -i ",filePath," --view 3 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", folderPath, atlasName,"_3.png")
  return(c(system(view1, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view2, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view3, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input)))
}
render_atlas(MNIcoord = 107,filePath = "/Applications/BrainSuite17a/svreg/BrainSuiteAtlas1/mri.bfc.nii.gz", folderPath = "/Users/sarapesavento/Desktop/tbm_anova/", atlasName="atlas")
```

###Table
```{r}
render_table <- function() {
  
t <- c("#test3","#test4","#test5","#test6","#test7")
Cluster <- 1:5
table <- data.frame(Cluster = 1:5, Vol_Size = c(33,22.3, 21, 25, 30), MNI_coord = c(3,3,4,5,3), T_val =c(8,7.2,6,9.8,7.8))
table$Cluster <- paste0("[", table$Cluster, "](", t, ")")
knitr::kable(table[1:4], align=c(rep('l', 4)))

}

render_table()
```
